method.input: Direct embedded GLB JSON/BIN parsing; all active-subtree Matrix4 transforms applied; actual indexed triangles, not accessor bounds alone
method.underwater: Select faces with all three transformed vertices Y<=0. Encode each point as Float32 little-endian XYZ; canonicalize cyclic corner rotations only, never reversed winding; sort the complete triangle multiset, retaining duplicates; compare count and SHA256 separately for each owner
method.fullGeometry: Same oriented triangle-multiset algorithm without the underwater selection
method.bodyApron: Clip every transformed upward-face triangle to X[-16,16], Z[-16,10]. Sum projected area and classify actual clipped Y at4.8 with tolerance1e-5; no sparse-probe-only flatness inference
method.capBoundary: Actual exported top triangles entirely above each frozen cut_y; exact-position welding for the triangle-edge incidence boundary. Single degree2 boundary loop; lower cut loop retained independently. Top counts/area/interior vertices measured from real geometry
method.capCoplanarity: Unweighted least-squares fit y=a*x+b*z+c to actual unique top vertices; residuals are vertical metres, not orthogonal plane distances. Actual heights also measured against the stored R3 dominant-cap plane
method.pngPbr: Actual embedded PNG payload byte hashes and dimensions; decoded material/texture/sampler JSON arrays compared independently. A separate read-only agent additionally compared the original raw JSON substrings
